scientific_integrity.evidence: Analytic covariance identities and global scalar derivative signs, independently tested via exact and numerical stationary Lyapunov solutions

scientific_limitations: Two identical unit masses and one positive interparticle spring are assumed.
Local Langevin baths must be independent, Markovian, thermal, and have strictly positive damping.
Total local pinning is positive but either individual pinning strength may vanish.
The arbitrary-coupling stationary heat-current formula is known from Simón et al. (2020); only the complete joint fixed-budget optimizer phase diagram is claimed.
Historical priority of the two-budget optimization is provisional, and no independent validation has occurred.
title: Spontaneous transport-design symmetry breaking in a two-bath harmonic dimer
